title: 第23章 欢喜神功第24章 迷人的女支书
content_zh:
;;
刘露露这样的狐狸眼睛，真让陈楚无法拒绝。
体内的欢喜鏖战大法更是活跃。
关键时刻，陈楚看向屋外走动的几个女人。
忙喊了一声。
“刚才是谁说她家的老母猪要接产来着？”
“我家！”
马上一个大老娘们站了出来。
“你贵姓？”
“我姓张。”
“张婶儿，现在就去你家，给你家的母猪接产。”
“陈医生，您刚才不是说，不给母猪接产吗？”
陈楚已经起身往外走了。
拉着张婶儿。
“走吧，母猪的命也是命，救人一命胜造七级浮屠，救母猪一命，至少也能胜六级浮屠的。”
外面站着的一群人，又赶去张婶儿家。
炕头上的刘露露咬了咬嘴唇。
忽然噗嗤一笑：“陈大傻，我就不信你躲得了初一，躲的了十五？跑得了和尚，你跑的了庙？”
……
陈楚赶到了张婶儿家。

张婶儿别看长得肥胖。
但她家有一个女儿，叫张小桃，今年19岁，长得粉嫩粉嫩的。
见家里来了个半大小子，还是医生，相貌还帅气，不免面色粉红起来。
“张婶儿，你家的老母猪呢？”
一边的张婶儿见女儿眼神，就有些明白了，自己女儿对这小子有那种意思。
“陈医生，你先里面坐一会儿，我家的母猪因为要生猪仔，所以在仓房里。”
张婶儿找钥匙去开仓房。
陈楚这边手掌一翻，身后多了个小药箱，又多了个白大褂，这是他在城里卖白菜的时候顺便买的。
很快，穿戴好了。
一旁的张小桃忍不住惊讶问。
“陈医生，您这小药箱还有白大褂放在哪里了？咋一变就出来了？”
“哦，我会魔术。”
“真的假的？”
陈楚见她可爱的样子。
兜她说：“我还会相面算命呢。”
张小桃来了兴致。
“那你给我算算呗。”
她伸出细嫩手掌。
陈楚握着她的小手，感觉一阵阵的电流袭击全身。

Liu Lulu's foxy eyes really made Chen Chu unable to refuse.
The joyful fighting spirit in the body is even more active.
At the critical moment, Chen Chu looked at the women walking outside the house.
He shouted quickly.
"Who just said that her old sow is going to give birth?"
"My home!"
Immediately an old lady stood up.
"What's your last name?"
"My surname is Zhang."
"Aunt Zhang, I'm going to your house now to deliver your sow."
"Dr. Chen, didn't you just say that you won't deliver sows?"
Chen Chu had already stood up and walked out.
Pulling Aunt Zhang.
"Let's go, a sow's life is also a life. Saving a human life is better than building a seven-level pagoda. Saving a sow's life is at least better than building a six-level pagoda."
A group of people standing outside rushed to Aunt Zhang's house again.
Liu Lulu bit her lip on the bed.
Suddenly he chuckled: "Chen Dasha, I don't believe you can escape from the first grade of junior high school, or the fifteenth grade? You can escape from the monk, but you can escape from the temple?"
…
Chen Chu rushed to Aunt Zhang's house.
Aunt Zhang, don’t look fat.
But her family has a daughter named Zhang Xiaotao, who is 19 years old and looks pink and tender.
Seeing a half-grown man coming to the house, a doctor and handsome, his face turned pink.
"Aunt Zhang, where is your old sow?"
Aunt Zhang on the side saw the look in her daughter's eyes and understood somewhat that her daughter had that kind of interest in this boy.
"Dr. Chen, please sit inside for a while. My sow is in the barn because she has to give birth to piglets."
Aunt Zhang looked for the key to open the warehouse.
Chen Chu flipped his hand, and there was a small medicine box and a white coat behind him, which he bought by the way when he was selling cabbage in the city.
Soon, I was dressed.
Zhang Xiaotao on the side couldn't help but asked in surprise.
"Dr. Chen, where did you put your little medicine box and your white coat? Why did you come out in such a sudden change?"
"Oh, I can do magic."
"Really or not?"
Chen Chu saw her cute look.
She said, "I can also tell people's fortunes."
Zhang Xiaotao became interested.
"Then you can do the math for me."
She stretched out her delicate palms.
Chen Chu held her little hand and felt waves of electric current hitting his whole body.
